description: C++ inference engine behind an OpenAI-compatible API, running inside Lemonade on AMD Ryzen AI: the XDNA 2 NPU, HRX and Vulkan on the iGPU, ZINC for NVIDIA and Apple GPUs, MLX on Apple.
rules: Serve models with `1bit serve`; it exposes an OpenAI-compatible API and runs as Lemonade's `onebit` backend.
Pick the device with `--device` (auto, npu, vulkan, hrx, rocm, zinc, mlx); an NPU model directory runs on the NPU fast lane, and Vulkan is the usual choice for plain GGUF files.
Prefer Unsloth Dynamic GGUFs: UD-Q4_K_XL is the lean default, UD-Q5_K_XL the accurate choice.
For one user at a time use `--mtp` without `--adaptive`; for many simultaneous requests use `--parallel` or `--adaptive`.
Documentation lives at https://1bit.gg; measured results are on the GitHub wiki.
